title: iCast-Stents in endobronchial stenosis: data from a retrospective single-centre-study
summary: The iCast-Stent - originally designed for the treatment of the arteries of the kidney and the pelvic - is also useful in the airways and especially in the bronchi of the lunglobes.
conditions: Endobronchial stenosis of different origins which mean an indication for stent-insertion

interventions.name: All Ruhrlandklinik-patients who were treated with an iCast-Stent since 2015 due to endobronchial stenosis.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
all patients who underwent an insertion of an iCast-Stent
Exclusion criteria:
all patients without an insertion of an iCast-Stent
